summary: Iteration 12 verified the FX 0.4681% exchange-buffer (HAIRCUT=0.995319). Backend math is correct end-to-end for /api/fx and /api/car/{id}: market 1653.5453, published 1645.8049, arithmetic exact. Reference car 41995353 matches expected chain exactly (encar_eur 32,142.33 -> car_eur 34,661.02 -> customs_base 6,238.98 -> duty 623.90 -> vat 1,372.58 -> landed 38,257.49 -> suggested_sale €38,799). Manual override end-to-end via PUT /api/settings works: setting fx_overrides.fx_krw_eur=1700 -> /api/fx returns fx_krw_eur exactly 1700 and fx_haircut 1.0; clearing it -> rate returns to market*HAIRCUT. Regressions (dup-key warning, Radix DialogTitle/Description) are GONE - console clean on /car/41995353 with the lightbox open, 26 imgs stacked vertically. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: list-row prices do NOT match detail-page prices — every row is exactly €100 (one charm bucket) below the detail price because the listings DB was last repriced with the un-buffered market rate. All 3 sampled cars mismatch: 42318384 list €15,099 vs detail €15,199; 42212840 €15,699 vs €15,799; 42147316 €20,699 vs €20,799. GET /api/settings shows last_repriced_at:null and last_repriced_count:null.

critical.issue: sale_eur in list rows is priced from the un-buffered market rate; suggested_sale in the detail quote is priced from the buffered rate (market * 0.995319). Delta is ~€45 landed which shifts the charm-rounded sale by exactly one €100 bucket for all 3 sampled cars. The listings collection needs a full reprice against the current buffered rate. Root cause: sync/reprice_all was never run after HAIRCUT was introduced (last_repriced_at is null). Fix: run sync_mod.reprice_all once (or PUT /api/settings with reprice:true and the current constants) so every listing row is re-persisted with the buffered fx_krw_eur.

action_items: CRITICAL: Reprice the entire listings catalogue against the current buffered fx_krw_eur so search rows stop being €100 below detail prices. One line for the operator: `curl -X PUT -H 'x-admin-token: encar-admin' -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"constants":{},"fx_overrides":{},"reprice":true}' <BASE>/api/settings` (or call sync_mod.reprice_all(db) directly). Verify by re-running backend/tests/test_fx_haircut.py::test_list_vs_detail_price_match — it should go green with no code changes.

OPTIONAL: Wire the FX bundle refresh path so that whenever a fresh live fetch changes fx_krw_eur by more than a small threshold, reprice_all runs automatically — otherwise this drift will re-appear the next time the KRW rate moves and the listings will lag detail again.
critical_code_review_comments: fx.py _apply_haircut correctly guards against double-discounting when a manual override is present (verified end-to-end).
fx.py stores the raw live rate in Mongo and applies the haircut in-memory on every read — good: the audit trail keeps the market rate, and changing HAIRCUT does not require re-fetching.

sync.py reprice_all uses rates['fx_krw_eur'] which is the buffered value, so a single reprice pass will fix the current mismatch. The bug is purely that this reprice hasn't been triggered since the haircut shipped (last_repriced_at is null).
pricing.charm() rounds UP as spec requires, which is why the mismatch shows up as an exact €100 delta (adjacent charm buckets) rather than a €45 landed-cost delta.

rca of the issue: RCA — list vs detail price mismatch: (1) fx.get_rates now returns a buffered fx_krw_eur (market * 0.995319) via _apply_haircut, correctly. (2) server.py GET /api/car/{id} uses this buffered rate at request time, so detail prices reflect the buffer. (3) But listings rows carry a precomputed sale_eur that was stored by sync_mod when the previous rate bundle did NOT include the haircut. GET /api/settings confirms last_repriced_at is null — reprice_all has never run against the buffered rate. Result: every row is priced from ~1653.5 KRW/EUR instead of ~1645.8, giving a landed cost ~€45 lower, which crosses one charm bucket and shows up as an exact €100 lower sale. Reproduction: POST /api/search, take any item, compare sale_eur to GET /api/car/{id}.quote.suggested_sale — 3/3 mismatch by €100. Mitigation: one-off `PUT /api/settings` with reprice:true (or `await sync_mod.reprice_all(db)`), then verify pytest goes green. Long-term: hook reprice_all into fx.get_rates whenever the fetched rate diverges from doc['fx_krw_eur'] by more than a configurable epsilon.
